title: Sharp coefficient, logarithmic and Schwarzian estimates for $α$-convex functions on the real line
summary: The class $M_α$ of $α$-convex functions, introduced by Mocanu in 1969, interpolates between starlike ($α=0$) and convex ($α=1$) mappings and has traditionally been studied only for $α\geq0$. We show that several of its sharp invariant estimates in fact extend to the entire real line.
